value.body: A three-year postgraduate degree after BHMS in one branch of homoeopathy, such as Materia Medica, Organon of Medicine, Repertory or Practice of Medicine. It combines clinical work in a teaching hospital with a dissertation. The course is regulated by the National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH).

items.label: Entrance exam
items.note: Conducted by NTA; common to MD/MS in Ayurveda, Homoeopathy, Siddha and Unani

items.label: AIAPGET 2025 — Homoeopathy stream
items.note: All four AYUSH streams together: ~43,800 registered, ~42,100 appeared

items.label: PG students in homoeopathy
items.note: All years of PG homoeopathy programmes; about 70% are women
items.source: AISHE 2022-23 and 2023-24 (Ministry of Education), institutions that reported

value.title: How you get in
value.body: BHMS with a completed internship and registration. Admission is through AIAPGET, conducted by NTA. All-India quota seats are allotted by the AYUSH Admissions Central Counselling Committee (AACCC); state quota seats are allotted by state counselling authorities.

value.title: At a glance
items: PG seats are far fewer than the number of BHMS graduates each year, so competition is real.
Fees and stipends differ a lot between government and private colleges.
It leads to teaching posts in homoeopathy colleges, specialist practice and some government roles.

value.title: Postgraduate enrolment in homoeopathy
value.note: Based on institutions that responded to AISHE, so the national total may be higher. Counts students across all PG years, not seats.
